visualRisks.description: Water and road colors are very similar, which may cause confusion.
visualRisks.suggestion: Increase the contrast between water and road colors.

visualRisks.description: Some paths are not clearly visible due to lack of color or pattern differentiation.
visualRisks.suggestion: Enhance the visibility of the route by using a distinct color or pattern.

navigationRisks.description: The route path contains repeated steps, which may lead to user frustration and confusion.
navigationRisks.suggestion: Review and optimize the route to ensure it is efficient and clear.

navigationRisks.description: There are no visual indicators for the start or end of the route, making navigation difficult.
navigationRisks.suggestion: Add distinct markers at the beginning and end of the route path.
